column2: Shortly after the death of [FromFrom.GetBestName] I was approached by a servant carrying a newborn child. The child looked a bit like [FromFrom.GetBestName], and the servant asked if it is possible that [FromFrom.GetSheHe] might have been reborn as little [From.GetFirstName].
Truly the child is [FromFrom.GetBestName] reborn!
If this child is related to me, it is clearly someone's bastard!
This is just a trick!

Several prominent merchants in [Root.GetName] have presented a petition to request the financing of a vastly expanded marketpace in the province to encourage more trade along that particular stretch of the Silk Road.
More trade would benefit me greatly!
I think I will spend the money on other things...
I have been approached with a proposal to construct a Paper Mill in [Root.GetName]. If the predictions I have seen are to be believed, this would benefit both me and the people of [Root.GetName].
Make it so!
I'd rather keep the money...

I have been approached with a proposal to establish a Fireworks Guild in [Root.GetName]. If the predictions I have seen are to be believed, this would benefit both me and the people of [Root.GetName].
Make it so!
I'd rather keep the money...

I have been approached with a proposal to establish an Administrative Outpost in [Root.GetName]. If the predictions I have seen are to be believed, this would benefit both me and the people of [Root.GetName].
Make it so!
I'd rather keep the money...
I have been approached with a proposal to construct a Blast Furnace in [Root.GetName]. If the predictions I have seen are to be believed, this would benefit both me and the people of [Root.GetName].
Make it so!
I'd rather keep the money...
I have been approached with a proposal to construct some Dry Docks in [Root.GetName]. If the predictions I have seen are to be believed, this would benefit both me and the people of [Root.GetName].
Make it so!
I'd rather keep the money...
To my great surprise, I was asked to dance by [From.GetBestName]. I had thought that someone with only one leg would be a terrible dancer, but I was pleasantly surprised.
That was rather fun!
To my great surprise, I was asked to dance by [From.GetBestName]. Less surprising, [From.GetHerHim] only having one leg made it all rather embarrassing.
I will not be dancing with [From.GetHerHim] again...
The Glorious Monument in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Merchant Harbor in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Scholar Foundation in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Great Library in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Center of Worship in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Logging Company in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Ore Mine in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Regimental Grounds in [Root.GetName] have been destroyed.
The Silk Road Market in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Paper Mill in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Fireworks Guild in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Administrative Outpost in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Blast Furnace in [Root.GetName] has been destroyed.
The Dry Docks in [Root.GetName] have been destroyed.
Sometimes I worry that [From.GetBestName] is working [From.GetHerHim]self into an early grave. As [From.GetHerHis] Court Physician, maybe I should say something about it.
[From.GetSheHeCap] should try to rest more!
[From.GetSheHeCap] likely knows [From.GetHerHis] own endurance better than I do...

Some of the servants have been training a dog to guide [From.GetBestName], seeing as [From.GetSheHe] is blind. Now the training seems to be at an end, and it is up to me whether the dog truly is right for [From.GetBestName].
I will give [From.GetHerHim] the dog!
I think [From.GetSheHe] can dp just fine without a dog...

I believe I have discovered some previously unheard of medical treatments that might be worth sharing with the world. Of course, producing a suitable book would require quite the investment, and it would only be right and proper if [From.GetBestName] paid me to do it as I am working for [From.GetHerHim].
I will request the necessary funds!
Actually, I don't feel like writing anything...

It seems [From.GetBestName] does not think highly of books concerning medicine and medical treatments, or that [From.GetSheHe] does not think highly of my skills, seeing as [From.GetSheHe] did not see fit to fund my book.
I see...

The hospital in [hospital_location.GetName] attracts skilled physicians from far and wide, and I could perhaps learn something there or share what I know, if [From.GetBestName] approves of me spending time there rather than at [From.GetHerHis] court.
I will ask [From.GetHerHim]!
Actually, I don't want to visit the hospital...

I have a nice time at the hospital in [hospital_location.GetName], and the physicians working there were both willing to learn from me and to teach me what they knew. In short, I am a better physician now than I was before.
Knowledge is power!
The time I spent at the hospital in [hospital_location.GetName] was pleasant enough, and I managed to discover a few insights that I had not come across before.
I learned some new things!

It is time for me to end my visit to the hospital in [hospital_location.GetName]. I barely spent any time at the actual hospital, seeing as the local physicians preferred for us to talk about things in other settings, such as over a nice meal or while attending a gathering of local notables.
Maybe I got a bit sidetracked...
[From.GetBestName] has approached me about a treatment from the pain [From.GetSheHe] is suffering from, which seems to be related to a body part that [From.GetSheHe] no longer possesses.
I will provide what help I can!
[From.GetSheHeCap] will learn the true meaning of pain!
The treatment I provided for [From.GetBestName] apparently worked quite well, seeing as [From.GetHerHis] pain seems to be fully gone.
I expect [From.GetSheHe] is pleased!
It seems the potion [From.GetBestName] got from me has caused [From.GetHerHim] to have to make frequent trips to the privy.
These things happen...

It seems [From.GetBestName]'s body is suffering greatly from the treatment I provided, seeing as [From.GetSheHe] no longer is capable of leaving [From.GetHerHis] bed for long. Even worse, [From.GetSheHe] seems to blame me for not helping [From.GetHerHim] with [From.GetHerHis] pain as [From.GetSheHe] asked me to.
I told [From.GetHerHim] the treatment was experimental!

[From.GetBestName] has involved [From.GetHerHim]self in my work during the last few days, and together we have managed to brew quite potent potions. I honestly do not know whether I taught [From.GetHerHim] more than [From.GetSheHe] taught me or if it was the other way around.
We should do this again!

[From.GetBestName] has involved [From.GetHerHim]self in my work during the last few days, and it has been an enjoyable time for me and seems to have given [From.GetHerHim] some insights into what it actually is that I do as [From.GetHerHis] Court Physician.
Please feel free to join me again!
[From.GetBestName] has involved [From.GetHerHim]self in my work during the last few days, and though [From.GetSheHe] has not proven a very gifted student [From.GetSheHe] has learned a few things.
I suppose the time wasn't completely wasted...
[From.GetBestName] tried to involve [From.GetHerHim]self in my work today, but the fumes rising from my potions apparently gave [From.GetHerHim] a headache and made [From.GetHerHim] reconsider.
Perhaps they take some time getting used to...

[From.GetBestName] tried to involve [From.GetHerHim]self in my work today, but almost as soon as [From.GetSheHe] had entered the laboratory [From.GetSheHe] has given me for my work as [From.GetHerHis] Court Physician [From.GetSheHe] stumbled and pulled a number of surgical tools down on [From.GetHerHim]self as [From.GetSheHe] fell to the floor.
I guess I have another patient to see to...
[sickly_infant.GetBestName] was not born a healthy child, and [sickly_infant.GetSheHe] might die without proper care. I should offer [infant_guardian.GetBestName] to treat the child.
I can save [sickly_infant.GetHerHim]!
It would be a shame if [sickly_infant.GetSheHe] died due to improper treatment. A real pity...

[From.GetBestName] has refused to permit me to treat [sickly_infant.GetBestName], stating that if [sickly_infant.GetBestName] dies then [sickly_infant.GetSheHe] was not strong enough to survive the horrors of this world.
I see...

Little [sickly_infant.GetBestName] is doing much better now. If I had not seen how sickly [sickly_infant.GetSheHe] was with my own eyes, I would not have believed that [sickly_infant.GetSheHe] was not born healthy.
I did good work!
[sickly_infant.GetBestName] is still not as strong as other babies [sickly_infant.GetHerHis] age, but [sickly_infant.GetSheHe] seems to be doing a little better than before.
I think it helped...
That's not what I wanted...
After I treated [sickly_infant.GetBestName] [sickly_infant.GetHerHis] health seems to have taken a turn for the worse. It is possible [sickly_infant.GetSheHe] will not survive for long.
Not good!
Excellent!

[sickly_infant.GetBestName], the sickly child I treated, has died. Everyone at court keeps telling me that it is sad the little [sickly_infant.GetBoyGirl] did not make it, and I do my best to sound sincere when I respond, seeing as I was actually hoping for the child to die.
Sad. Yes.
It seems word has spread regarding my abilities as a Court Physician, seeing as people now are coming from far and wide to seek treatment or advice from me.
Finally my genius is recognized!

[From.GetBestName] has requested that I try to determine what might be behind the symptoms [From.GetSheHe] is suffering from. As best I can tell, [From.GetSheHe] is suffering from [From.GetCourtPhysicianDiagnosis]. I am [From.GetCourtPhysicianDiagnosisCertainty] about this diagnosis.
I will of course present a truthful diagnosis.
Why tell the truth about the matter?
Consumption
Slow Fever
Camp Fever
the Bubonic Plague
Measles
Smallpox
Syphilis
the Flu
Dysentery
Gout
a bout of Food Poisoning
Rabies
Cancer
Pneumonia
the Great Pox
nothing serious
most certain
fairly confident
somewhat sure
quite uncertain
It is not hard to come up with some alternatives as to what [FromFrom.GetBestName] actually might be suffering from.
It's [From.GetFakeDiagnosisA]! Definitely [From.GetFakeDiagnosisA]!
You are suffering from [From.GetFakeDiagnosisA]!
The symptoms point towards it being [From.GetFakeDiagnosisC]!
It being [From.GetFakeDiagnosisD] seems plausible enough...
I gave [From.GetBestName] a talisman made from a chicken bone and told [From.GetHerHim] that carrying it around would lessen the severity of [From.GetHerHis] abdominal pain.
I rubbed a scented oil on [From.GetBestName]'s stomach to help [From.GetHerHim] with [From.GetHerHis] abdominal pain.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s abdominal pain I rubbed [From.GetHerHis] stomach for the better part of an hour.
I had [From.GetBestName]'s room refurnished so that [From.GetHerHis] bed would face the rising sun, all in the name of helping [From.GetHerHim] with [From.GetHerHis] chest pain.
I locked [From.GetBestName] inside [From.GetHerHis] chambers with a small lizard, which perhaps will help with [From.GetHerHis] chest pain.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s chest pain I had [From.GetHerHim] sleep with [From.GetHerHis] door open, all to let the spirits in.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s cough by telling [From.GetHerHim] to drink some goat's milk with a little honey in it.
I made sure to instruct [From.GetBestName] to gargle a salty infusion of licorice root and thyme in order to treat [From.GetHerHis] cough.
I instructed [From.GetBestName] to lean over a boiling pot of water to breathe in the steam, seeing as that might help with [From.GetHerHis] cough.
[From.GetBestName] got strict instructions from me to stand in a bucket of warm water to make [From.GetHerHis] cramps to go away.
I made sure to give [From.GetBestName] a nugget of metal to put in [From.GetHerHis] mouth every night, telling [From.GetHerHim] that it might cure [From.GetHerHis] cramps.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s cramps I gave [From.GetHerHim] specific instructions to rub [From.GetHerHis] limbs with vinegar each morning and evening.
[From.GetBestName]'s diarrhea required me to give [From.GetHerHim] specific dietary instructions. No more spices or fatty foods for [From.GetHerHim]!
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s diarrhea with a steaming cup of chamomille tea.
I suggested that [From.GetBestName] should eat ten apples a day to make [From.GetHerHis] diarrhea go away. Of course, it will not keep me from checking on [From.GetHerHim].
[From.GetBestName]'s fatigue required me to give [From.GetHerHim] specific dietary instructions. I prescribed plenty of spicy foods.
The best treatment I could administer for [From.GetBestName]'s fatigue was rubbing [From.GetHerHis] hands and feet with peppermint leaves.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s fatigue I gave [From.GetHerHim] a draught of milk and poppy.
A freezing footbath was the treatment I settled on for [From.GetBestName]'s fever.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s fever by giving [From.GetHerHim] a hot potion. [From.GetSheHeCap] complained that it tasted rather sour.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s fever I wrapped [From.GetHerHim] in wet linen cloth.
After inquring about the specifics of the fever [From.GetBestName] is suffering from I decided that the proper cure was to chant "Abracadabra!".
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms with a bloodletting, seeing as that might restore [From.GetHerHis] humors to the desired balance.
I made sure to make [From.GetBestName] sprint around all day to work up a sweat and rebalance [From.GetHerHis] humors.
[From.GetBestName]'s symptoms required me to induce vomiting, so I gave [From.GetHerHim] some salty water to drink.
I prescribed a three day fast for [From.GetBestName], as it might have an effect on [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms I covered [From.GetHerHis] body with leeches, telling [From.GetHerHim] they would draw out the illness.
I made sure to tell [From.GetBestName] that [From.Religion.GetHighGodName] would cure [From.GetHerHis] symptoms if [From.GetSheHe] spent more time in prayer.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms by having [From.GetHerHim] drink some human breast milk donated from the wet nurses at court.
Some walks in the wilderness might have the desired effect on [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms, so that is what I prescribed for [From.GetHerHim].

[From.GetBestName]'s symptoms might be related to [From.GetHerHim] laughing more than [From.GetSheHe] really should, so I decided to forbid jokes in [From.GetHerHis] presence and to give [From.GetHerHim] some boring tomes to read.
I told [From.GetBestName] to sleep hanging upside down for a few days to get rid of [From.GetHerHis] symptoms. I am told it made [From.GetHerHim] feel like a bat.
I made sure to consult the stars before draining a good quantity of [From.GetBestName]'s blood, all in the name of curing [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms was to have [From.GetHerHim] burn a parchment on which the names of [From.GetHerHis] worst enemies had been written down.
I lit some candles and had [From.GetBestName] join me in a chant in a long-dead language calling upon [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName]'s attention and assistance with [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms.
I made sure to extensively study the stars before I prescribed a fairly long period of fasting for [From.GetBestName], all to help with [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms I strapped [From.GetHerHim] to a chair several nights in a row to ensure that [From.GetSheHe] had no choice but to sleep in an upright position.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms by having [From.GetHerHim] join me late at night to gaze upon the stars and reconnect with the moon.
[From.GetBestName]'s symptoms required me to bring out my acupuncture kit.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms by having [From.GetHerHim] sleep in a [From.GetHouseOfWorship] for a fortnight.
I brought several musicians with me to [From.GetBestName]'s chambers and had them play some soothing music to deal with [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms I helped [From.GetHerHim] with some breathing exercises and a little meditation.
I instructed [From.GetBestName] to try abstaining from sin, seeing as [From.Religion.GetHighGodName] perhaps might be behind [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.

While I am not privy to what goes on in [From.GetBestName]'s bedchamber I suggested that [From.GetSheHe] should abstain from lovemaking and related activities for at least a fortnight, considering [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.

It is possible [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms are related to what [From.GetSheHe] does in [From.GetHerHis] bedchamber, alone or in the company of others. I provided some anatomical drawings on the subject, suggesting that perhaps some variety might help [From.GetHerHim].
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms by having [From.GetHerHim] bathe more frequently.
I made sure to give [From.GetBestName] a glass of water with some strong spices in it to deal with [From.GetHerHis] headache.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s headache by having [From.GetHerHim] rest for a bit.
I made sure to fill [From.GetBestName]'s pillows with dried lavender and peppermint, seeing as it might have an effect on [From.GetHerHis] headache.
[From.GetBestName] got a feeding bag full of oats to consume in order to treat [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms by rubbing a liniment all over [From.GetHerHis] body.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s symptoms I administered a swift kick to [From.GetHerHis] chest.
I took [From.GetBestName] to a meadow and made [From.GetHerHim] roll around in the grass, hoping it would have an effect on [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.
I took the time to brush [From.GetBestName]'s hair for several hours, all in the name of treating [From.GetHerHis] symptoms.
[From.GetBestName] was instructed to start delegating more and to worry less, all in the name of dealing with [From.GetHerHis] malaise.
I made sure to give [From.GetBestName] a sticky ointment to rub on [From.GetHerHis] chest for the time being, seeing as it might have an effect on [From.GetHerHis] malaise.
[From.GetBestName]'s diarrhea required me to give [From.GetHerHim] specific dietary instructions. More spices or fatty foods would be proper for [From.GetHerHim]!
After considering the specifc nature of [From.GetBestName]'s rash I had [From.GetHerHis] bed clad in wet grass so that [From.GetSheHe] could sleep in nature's embrace.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s rash by having [From.GetHerHim] use a poultice each night at midnight.
[From.GetBestName] was given a mixture of goat's milk and the fat of a boar to smear on [From.GetHerHis] rashes.
I made sure to have [From.GetBestName] sleep with an acorn under [From.GetHerHis] pillow in order to deal with [From.GetHerHis] vomiting.
I decided that it would be best to treat [From.GetBestName]'s vomiting was to rub the servants with a scented oil, as their uncleanliness might be the cause.
To help with [From.GetBestName]'s vomiting I had [From.GetHerHim] drink a tall glass of rare onion water after each meal.
[From.GetHerHisCap] symptoms seem to have become less severe
[From.GetHerHisCap] condition seems unchanged
[From.GetBestName] has come to me seeking a treatment for [From.GetHerHis] ailments.
I will treat [From.GetHerHim] to the best of my ability!
Ha! The fool should never have given me this opportunity to harm [From.GetHerHim]!

After considering the different kinds of treatments I mentioned to [From.GetHerHim] for a short while [From.GetBestName] has asked me to perform some kind of experimental treatment, seeing as that might be more effective than a tried an true method. Now I need to decide on the specific treatment.
Bring me the bees!
Where did I put that severed hand?
The various properties of mercury have always fascinated me...
A naked run through the wilderness would be best!
I think some brimstone combined with the gall-bladder of a rabid beaver might do wonders here!
Making a small incision and applying some diseased tissue would be a promising approach!
Assistant! Start grinding up those scabs!
I will have to remove [From.GetHerHis] eye...
This will require [From.GetBestName]'s castration!
It might have an effect on [From.GetHerHis]'s sanity, but surgery is required here!
[From.GetHerHisCap]'s face needs to go!
The hand will have to be amputated...
The treatment will cost [From.GetHerHim] a leg.
I've wanted to use the brain of that rabid dog I found for a while...
We'll need the fish that shocks people!

After considering the different kinds of treatments I mentioned to [From.GetHerHim] for a short while [From.GetBestName] has asked me to perform some kind of mystical treatment, seeing as that might be more effective than a tried an true method. Now I need to decide on the specific treatment.
Time to reach across realms to the other [From.GetFirstName]!
Assistants! Prepare a great animal sacrifice!
Some oil on [From.GetBestName]'s hand and a little heat would likely work well enough...
[From.GetSheHeCap] will be told to smoke a pipe with some... medical herbs!
Get me the goats, the knife, and the bathtub!
I've always wanted to use this potion!
Heat the coals and take off [From.GetBestName]'s boots!
[From.GetBestName]'s head needs to go underwater for a while...
The desired outcome demands a sacrifice!
Time for [From.GetHerHim] to embark on a vision quest!
I will link [From.GetHerHis] health to a rat and call upon divine assistance!
My life is a small price to pay for the desired outcome!

After considering the different kinds of treatments I mentioned to [From.GetHerHim] for a short while [From.GetBestName] has asked me to perform some kind of fairly regular treatment, telling me that something that is known to work is better than something that is not. Now I need to decide on the specific treatment.
If the stars will it, bloodletting is called for!
Where did I put that wooden trumpet?
Get me the leech!
I'll need the dung of a cow and the proper herbs for this...
Assistant! Get me a cat!
I'll get started on the toads right away!
Someone fetch me the urine of a pregnant sow!
I'm glad I kept that fish alive for this!
Bring me the spices!
And here I was considering getting rid of that particularly flatulent goat!
Something to induce the proper bowel movements would be called for here!
Cups! We need cups!
Where did I put that dried and powdered mugwort?

After considering the different kinds of treatments I mentioned to [From.GetHerHim] for a short while [From.GetBestName] has asked me to perform some kind of very limited treatment, perhaps out of a fear that the treatment might make things worse if I do not approach it correctly. Now I need to decide on the specific treatment.
Bed rest is called for here!
Vegetables and a herbal tea for [From.GetHerHim], I think...
I will rub and slap [From.GetHerHis] hands and feet!
A glass of water will work well...
Get me a feather!
Find me a [From.Religion.GetPriestTitle]!
Get me a copy of [From.Religion.GetScriptureName]!
A [From.Religion.GetPriestTitle] singing for [From.GetHerHim] would work well...
Heat some water and get me some honey!
Where did I put that herb I need...?
A silver ring lined with black ram's wool might help...
Get me some henna and a brush!

After listening to me describe a few possible treatments [From.GetBestName] told me that [From.GetSheHe] actually thinks that [From.GetSheHe] will be able to get better on [From.GetHerHis] own after all and that I should refrain from treating [From.GetHerHim] for the time being.
But I can help you!
I wonder if [From.GetSheHe] maybe suspected my true intentions...
I provided the experimental treatment for [From.GetBestName]'s ailments I had decided upon.
[From.GetSheHeCap] got a lot better, just as I was hoping!
[From.GetSheHeCap] got a lot better, despite me going for the opposite!
[From.GetSheHeCap] got a bit better, if perhaps not as much as I was hoping...
[From.GetSheHeCap] got a bit better, unfortunately...

I went ahead with the tried and true treatment I decided upon after [From.GetBestName] told me to give [From.GetHerHim] such a treatment.
[From.GetSheHeCap] got a bit better, if perhaps not as much as I was hoping...
[From.GetSheHeCap] got a bit better, unfortunately...
[From.GetSheHeCap] got a bit worse, unfortunately...

Despite it barely qualifying as doing anything, I carried out the cautious treatment I settled upon after [From.GetBestName] requested such a treatment.
[From.GetSheHeCap] maybe got slightly better, which I suppose is the best I could hope for...
[From.GetSheHeCap] maybe got slightly better, which is unfortunate...
[From.GetHerHis] health is unchanged, which is unfortunate...

You will pay with your own life to ensure [From.GetBestName] gets better.
